remarks: **Highest and best by 2pm Monday 3/17** Welcome to this charming condominium in the heart of the Winnipauk Village complex. Nestled in a prime location, this 2 bedroom one and a half bath home offers easy access to all shopping needs, as well as convenient proximity to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, making commuting a breeze. Step inside to discover a beautifully updated space with modern finishes throughout. The home features updated appliances in the kitchen, crown molding, and a fresh new look with updated floors on the second level. Enjoy the luxurious, newly tiled bathrooms, complete with updated toilets, fixtures, vanity, and sinks for a spa-like experience. The updated closets add extra storage and organization to the home. One of the standout features of this unit is the stunning porch view, offering one of the best vistas in the village-perfect for enjoying peaceful moments or entertaining guests. With the added bonus of attic storage, you'll have plenty of space to keep your belongings organized. The best part? The new owner won't have to worry about making updates; this home is move-in ready, offering both style and convenience. Don't miss your chance to own this beautifully updated 2 bedroom condominium in Winnipauk Village!
